first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: green soccer field
entities.identification: The green grass playing field that covers the main part of the image and has white match markings.

entities.name: sideline advertising barrier
entities.identification: A collection of long advertising boards arranged around the perimeter of the field, bearing text and colored graphics.

entities.name: group of players in green clothing
entities.identification: A group of outfield players identifiable by predominantly green jerseys, green shorts, and white knee-high socks, excluding the goalkeeper and referee.

entities.name: group of players in dark clothing
entities.identification: A group of players on the field wearing dark tops, shorts, and soccer socks; blue-and-black vertical stripes are discernible in the second shot.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The goalkeeper active in front of the goal at the right end, wearing a red top, shorts, and knee-high socks.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The goalkeeper appearing as a bright-orange upright human figure in front of the far-end goal at the upper left in the opening wide shot.

entities.name: Person E
entities.identification: The referee active near the players on the field, wearing a bright-yellow top and black shorts.

entities.name: soccer ball
entities.identification: The small white spherical object moving near the players outside the penalty arc.

entities.name: Object D
entities.identification: The white goal defended by Person D at the far end in the upper left of the opening wide shot.

entities.name: Object E
entities.identification: The white goal defended by Person C, located in the upper right of the image in the second shot.

entities.name: gray tiered stands
entities.identification: The gray stands around the outside of the field, with tiered seating, section aisles, and railings.

entities.name: group of spectators in the stands
entities.identification: The group of spectators densely distributed throughout the seating areas of the stands.

entities.name: off-field group of people in vests
entities.identification: The group of people outside the field wearing bright-yellow or orange-red vests with dark lower garments.

entities.name: off-field gray rigid passageway
entities.identification: The gray hard-surfaced ground between the sideline facilities and the lower edge of the stands.

entities.name: illuminated display screen above the stands
entities.identification: The rectangular display screen with a dark border and a green illuminated image in the upper left of the opening segment.
